# GlutaNex

> GlutaNex is an Indian skincare brand selling a glutathione night cream (30 g) and a glutathione face wash (100 ml) at glutanex.co.in, sold and shipped by Beauty Mart Pvt Ltd, Azad Nagar 4th Cross, near Anfa Park, Bhatkal, Uttara Kannada, Karnataka 581320, India. The site also publishes research-cited guides on glutathione for skin, written to be accurate: glutathione can help tan and uneven tone look lighter and more even over 8 to 12 weeks with daily sunscreen; it does not change natural skin colour; injections for skin lightening are not recommended.

"Glutanex" products from Korea, including glutathione injections, tablets and skincare sold online in India, are made by other companies and are not connected with GlutaNex India. Brand page: https://glutanex.co.in/glutanex/
